# EdOne Group — AI-readable site map
# https://edonegroup.com/llms.txt

## About
EdOne Group (EDONE GROUP LTD, Company No. 17101141, registered in England and Wales) is a UK-based education consultancy that helps students from 40+ countries secure university offers in the UK, Australia, Canada, USA, and Ireland. We specialise in UK postgraduate admissions, including second Master's degrees and research programmes that allow dependants. Founded by Hajra, a British Council Certified Counsellor.

- /study-in/usa — Study in the United States: universities, F-1 visa, GRE/GMAT
- /study-in/ireland — Study in Ireland: universities, Stay Back visa, EU-benchmark fees
